name: Nijou Towa
source:
"Oh, I think I understand! Huh? I'm really doing this!?"

A proud elf knight.... actually, she's a useless elf. She is a nuisance that always acts before thinking. She is not truly stupid, but she seems to have problems on what she chooses to remembers and what she wants to act on. 
In reality, she is the only daughter of the Nijou Conglomerate, which runs the school, and is also the President of the "Nijou-kai", an organization of school students similar to a student council. However, because she is useless in reality, almost all of the operations seem to be carried out by her [url=/c113658]Vice President[/url].
Because of her background, she has been educated as a gifted child. On the rare occasion where her head is in the right place, she can say something sharp.
Although her appearance is that of a refined lady, she has a principle of not laughing as such.

[b][u]GAME SPEC[/u][/b]
Race: Elf
Height: 166 cm
Occupation: Knight
